facts.fact: 在 Arby’s，Jules 对 Bethany 说 “I need your help”，要她帮忙改进自己的新视频，并承认这听起来怪：他其实早就知道 Bethany 是谁——说着把纸三明治包装纸揉成一团丢在桌上让它滚。
facts.anchor: “Yeah. With my new video.” Jules crumpled up their paper sandwich wrapper and let it roll on the table. “Okay,” they said. “This is going to sound weird, but I actually know who you are.”

facts.fact: Jules 透露高中时就在看 Bethany 的 GlobalVill 视频——那时她看起来还像个男孩，但他照样认出了她，还说那些视频真的很棒。
facts.anchor: “Back in high school,” they said, “I watched your GlobalVill videos. You still looked like a boy then, but I recognized you anyway. They were really good. Your videos, I mean.”

facts.fact: 两人回到 Turbo Putt，Jules 从 mini fridge 后面的 secret shelf 里掏出笔记本电脑和大麻存货；Bethany 从 Jules 肩后偷看，瞥见那批毒品军火，还有他们那把从 Walmart 买的小黑手枪。
facts.anchor: Back at the Turbo Putt, Jules dug their laptop and weed stash out from the secret shelf behind the mini fridge. Bethany spied over Jules’s shoulder, catching a fleeting glimpse of their drug arsenal, as well as their small black handgun from Walmart.

facts.fact: Jules 按下播放键，让 Bethany 看一段尚未发布的 JulesPublicAccessAfterworld 新视频；屏幕里的 Jules 自报家门——你在看的是 Pink Eye TV，这是卡在我脑子里的电视节目的第一集，拍摄位正是 Bethany 此刻坐的位置。
facts.anchor: “You’re watching Pink Eye TV, and this is the first episode of the TV show stuck in my head,” the Jules on screen said. They were sitting in the exact spot Bethany was in right now.

facts.fact: Bethany 试探问 Public Access Afterworld 是不是 David Sawyer 那一类的 cult，Jules 反驳说那不是 cult、是调查真实超自然事件的网络社群：他已经参加两年多、马上就要到最高 access 等级。
facts.anchor: “It’s not a cult,” Jules snapped back. “It’s an online community that investigates real supernatural events. I’ve been a participant for over two years now, and I’m almost all the way to the highest level of access.”

facts.fact: Jules 揭出关键真相：先前的所谓最终测试，是吞下一大把 Tic Tacs、假装它们是药片并假装自己在自杀——帖子要求演得极其逼真、逼真到连你自己都开始相信，他还说这是 Public Access Afterworld 游戏的全部意义所在；Jules 承认自己就这么做了个假自杀视频（fake suicide video）。
facts.anchor: swallow a bunch of Tic Tacs and pretend they’re pills and that you’re killing yourself. That’s what the post said—to be really convincing that you’re actually killing yourself, so much so that you start to believe it yourself.

facts.fact: Jules 说发视频当夜 like midnight 警察就上门盘问，直到他出示用来造假的 Tic Tacs 才罢休；他差点丢了工作，并认定是当地高中那帮孩子（朝棚子射 BB 弹、举报视频）报的警。
facts.anchor: those pigs showed up here at like midnight that same night I posted my video, and interrogated me until I showed them the fucking Tic Tacs I used to fake it all. I almost lost my job.

facts.fact: Bethany 提醒说这一切听起来 intense 甚至 unsafe、问 David Sawyer 是不是个 murderer，Jules 笑称那只是主流媒体 conspiracies 的说法，随后反咬 Bethany：你可能觉得我信的东西又蠢又假，可你就坐在我对面、装得好像你自己真的是个女孩。
facts.anchor: Because you might think the stuff I believe in is dumb and fake, but you’re sitting right there across from me and acting like you’re actually a girl.
